text.p: Communications Systems International Inc said it entered into a letter of intent for a proposed underwritten public offering of approximately 1,000,000 shares of common stock and 1,000,000 redeemable common stock purchase warrants.

The company will sell one warrant with each share of common stock. Two common stock purchase warrants will entitle the holder to purchase one share of common stock at a price equal to 150 percent of the public offering price of the common stock.
The company said it anticipates that the offering will commence in June 1997, but it said substantial delays could occur.

Communication Systems says it intends to apply the proceeds of the offering to the reduction of certain debt, the installation of equipment to facilitate transparent callback service in several international locations, the expansion of the company's system capacity, research and development and for working capital.
